method.method_draft: Read the figure as a composite 'house' shape: a bottom rectangle/square and a triangular roof. From the image, the bottom base is labeled 6 and the left vertical side of the rectangle is labeled 6, so the rectangle area is 6×6. The roof sits on the rectangle’s top edge, so its base is also 6; the dashed perpendicular in the triangle is labeled 6, so the triangle height is 6. Add the rectangle area and triangle area: 6×6 + (1/2)×6×6 = 36 + 18 = 54.

method.method_draft: Assign coordinates to the polygon using the labeled lengths from the image. Let the bottom-left corner be (0,0), bottom-right be (6,0), top-right of the rectangle be (6,6), roof peak be (3,12) because the roof height is 6 above the rectangle top, and top-left of the rectangle be (0,6). method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图是一个“房子形”的五边形，由下方一个矩形和上方一个三角形屋顶组成。图中标出底边长度为 6，矩形左侧高度为 6；屋顶内部有一条竖直虚线标出屋顶高度为 6，并且虚线从屋顶顶点落到矩形顶边附近。图中还用直角标记表明矩形边水平、竖直，屋顶高度垂直于矩形顶边。

推理：按照指定方法给多边形设坐标。令左下角为 (0,0)，底边长 6，所以右下角为 (6,0)。矩形高为 6，所以矩形右上角为 (6,6)，左上角为 (0,6)。屋顶高度为 6，且屋顶顶点在宽为 6 的顶边中点上方，所以屋顶顶点为 (3,12)。按顺序取顶点：(0,0), (6,0), (6,6), (3,12), (0,6)。用鞋带公式：正向和为 0·0 + 6·6 + 6·12 + 3·6 + 0·0 = 126；反向和为 0·6 + 0·6 + 6·3 + 12·0 + 6·0 = 18。面积 = |126 - 18| / 2 = 54。因此图形面积为 54。
